old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-zoi0","title":"Provision verifier aliases mutable rollback state across trust and persistence hooks","description":"Timing security review: ProvisionVerifier validates a caller-supplied ProvisionRollbackState then stores that exact frozen-by-convention object in `__rollback`. `object.__setattr__` can lower its record_version after construction, allowing a signed intermediate version to overwrite a higher durable rollback floor. New candidate objects are also passed to `persist_rollback_state` and then stored internally, so the persistence hook can retain and mutate verifier state after returning. Detach authenticated rollback state into private primitive snapshots, pass a separate persistence value, and revalidate durability generation before commit. Add caller mutation before install, persistence-hook mutation after return, digest or encoded-record mutation, lower-version rejection, and reboot tests.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T08:25:23.731792Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T08:25:23.731792Z"}
